name: 04c-per-unit-letter
description: A per-unit is not followed by an ASCII letter or by one of the four letters with a fold of their own in SPEC §4. The letter é is not one of them, so mg/kgé is a per-unit and mg is not at the 10. The letter x and the long s end the per-unit reading, so mg is at the 20 and at the 30 (SPEC §4.3, #363).
document: Give 10 mg/kgé daily. Give 20 mg/kgx daily. Give 30 mg/kgſ daily.
